review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. The original PRD fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input, explicitly retains humanConfirmed=false, and requires only the selected branch; an empty human-decision input therefore does not contradict readiness=ready. A material unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions; this approval does not waive that gate. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001 and both task keys remain stable. The supplied implementation supports the specified existing backoff calculation and identifies the hook insertion point after termination checks, with a necessary post-hook cancellation check before waiting, including zero delay. The exact four-file binding scope covers the maintained implementation, public declaration, runtime regressions and tsd tests without requiring edits merely to touch every file. Package configuration and supplied tsd implementation establish separate runtime and compile-time verification paths. Task expectations preserve independent verification dependent on implementation. The allowed agents have the corresponding roles, available capacity and supplied original project-scoped active trusted claims, including data.change, domain.state, integration.consumer and verifier-only testing.verification; pending mappings and Persona do not supply eligibility. The selected verifier is permitted to serve as the independent read-only planning reviewer under the supplied policy. Historical project reuse preserves claim scope without treating old operations as fresh bundle evidence. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source domains, PRD trimming and executing-bundle prompt digest. Model, policy, sampling and budget identifiers are frozen consistently. This assessment relies on the Service's supplied mechanical digest bindings and provenance, not independent digest recomputation, code execution, test results or a new human attestation. No candidate outputs were used.
